definitions.gloss: dressing or making up to look younger
definitions.explanation: Dressing, styling or making up so as to look younger than one's age; often implies trying too hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{若作|わかづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father has been dressing younger lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{若作|わかづく}りすぎない？
examples.english: Isn't that outfit a bit too young for you?

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{若作|わかづく}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{年相応|としそうおう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{素敵|すてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think dressing your age looks better than forcing yourself to look young.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {若作|わかづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dress or make up young
- {若作|わかづく}りしすぎる: to overdo looking young
- {若作|わかづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes too young for the wearer

WATCH OUT:
{若作|わかづく}り is usually mildly critical. To compliment someone, say ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (looks young) or ⟦{若々|わかわか}しい→若々しい：18038_wakawakashii⟧ (youthful).
